title: Spicy Algerian Tagine Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy vegan stew made with a tagine, perfect for a hearty meal. This stew is inspired by North African cuisine and features a rich and aromatic flavor profile.
instructions: Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the algerian and acrid and cook until fragrant.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
